name: Schnick_Demo
summary: This EA is a demonstration script for a Support Vector Machine (SVM) learning tool. It generates synthetic training data based on a predefined 'Schnick' classification function, trains two SVMs (one with clean data and one with randomly inserted errors), then tests and compares their classification accuracy. It does not execute any actual trades.
summary_zh: 该EA是一个支持向量机(SVM)学习工具的演示脚本。它基于预定义的'Schnick'分类函数生成合成训练数据,训练两个SVM(一个使用无误差数据,另一个使用随机插入误差的数据),然后测试并比较它们的分类准确率。该EA不执行任何实际交易。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的策略概念是基于支持向量机(SVM)的二元分类,通过7个输入特征(身高、体重、腿数、眼数、臂长、平均速度、叫声频率)来判断一个虚拟生物'施尼克'是否属于特定物种。入场条件并不涉及真实市场交易,而是在OnInit中一次性生成5000个训练样本,每个样本包含7个随机生成的特征值。出场条件同样不适用,因为该EA仅执行分类测试后在初始化阶段结束。仓位管理和资金管理完全不存在,因为这是一个纯粹的机器学习演示工具,不涉及任何金融交易逻辑。该EA通过对比无误差训练数据和含500个随机误差训练数据下的SVM准确率,展示了SVM对噪声数据的鲁棒性。分类决策边界由isItASchnick函数硬编码的多维度范围判断定义,本质上是一个多维超矩形分类问题。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept of this EA is based on Support Vector Machine (SVM) binary classification, using 7 input features (height, weight, number of legs, number of eyes, arm length, average speed, call frequency) to determine whether a fictional creature 'Schnick' belongs to a specific species. Entry conditions do not involve real market trading; instead, 5000 training samples are generated once during OnInit, each containing 7 randomly generated feature values. Exit conditions are not applicable since the EA only performs a classification test and terminates during initialization. Position sizing and money management are completely absent, as this is a purely machine learning demonstration tool with no financial trading logic. The EA demonstrates SVM robustness to noisy data by comparing classification accuracy between clean training data and training data with 500 randomly inserted errors. The classification decision boundary is defined by the hard-coded multi-dimensional range checks in the isItASchnick function, which is essentially a multi-dimensional hyperrectangle classification problem.

pros: 清晰展示了SVM在MQL5中的集成使用方法
通过对比无误差和有误差数据的训练结果,直观展示SVM对噪声的鲁棒性
代码结构清晰,函数划分合理,注释充分便于理解
pros_en: Clearly demonstrates how to integrate SVM usage within MQL5
Intuitively shows SVM robustness to noise by comparing training results with and without errors
Clean code structure with well-separated functions and ample comments for understanding
cons: 不执行任何实际交易,仅是一个概念验证演示
分类标准硬编码在isItASchnick函数中,缺乏灵活性和实际市场适用性
训练和测试都在OnInit中一次性完成,无法在实时行情中持续学习和分类
cons_en: Does not execute any actual trades; it is merely a proof-of-concept demonstration
Classification criteria are hard-coded in the isItASchnick function, lacking flexibility and real-market applicability
Training and testing are performed once in OnInit, with no capability for continuous learning and classification on live market data
improvements: 将SVM分类应用于真实市场指标数据,实现基于机器学习的交易信号生成
增加实时分类功能,在OnTick中使用已训练的SVM对新到数据进行分类并生成交易信号
improvements_en: Apply SVM classification to real market indicator data to implement machine-learning-based trade signal generation
Add real-time classification capability, using the trained SVM in OnTick to classify incoming data and generate trading signals

risk_points: 该EA不执行交易,无市场风险
所有计算在初始化阶段完成,不影响运行时性能
risk_points_en: This EA does not execute trades, posing no market risk
All computations are completed during initialization, with no impact on runtime performance
